title: A small idea, shared
subtitle: Follow a little light from a first spark to a place for everyone.
motif: One amber lantern travels along a continuous path. It carries the idea across every scene, then lights the final garden.

scenes.title:
A small idea.
A shared world.
scenes.body: Every journey starts with something worth carrying.
scenes.narration: Every idea begins as a small spark. Here, a little light sets out through an unfinished world, looking for a place where it can become useful.
scenes.action: The lantern wakes beneath a welcoming arch and begins to move.

scenes.title:
Climb a little.
See a little more.
scenes.body: A new perspective makes the next step visible.
scenes.narration: The first path is rarely the whole answer. A staircase offers another perspective. Step by step, the little light finds a direction it could not see from the ground.
scenes.action: A stepped lookout rises in sequence as the lantern crosses the island.

scenes.title:
Try a shape.
Make it work.
scenes.body: Small experiments turn possibility into something concrete.
scenes.narration: At the workshop, separate pieces start to fit together. Some move, some settle, and a rough possibility becomes something that can be tried and improved.
scenes.action: Three hovering blocks settle onto a plinth while an open ring turns.

scenes.title:
Build a bridge.
Bring it along.
scenes.body: An idea travels further when someone else can reach it.
scenes.narration: A useful idea needs a way to travel. A bridge connects the work to another place, carrying both the result and the lessons learned along the way.
scenes.action: A bridge extends between two towers as the lantern approaches the next crossing.

scenes.title:
One little light.
Room for more.
scenes.body: The end of one journey can become someone else's beginning.
scenes.narration: The light arrives in a garden, where its glow helps something new take root. What began as one small idea has become a place for others to begin.
scenes.action: Flowers unfold around a central lantern tower, resolving the opening spark.
